source_boundaries.finding: Describes independent enable/disable flags and default-disabled state; does not explain String expansion dependence on Nat.
Both flags default false independently; no config-level rule enforces String => Nat.
NatLit admission checks Nat flag; StrLit checks String flag only. Neither case requires native declarations. This review generates no new serialized input.
mk_string_lit/quick depends only on String flag; mk_nat_lit/quick requires Nat flag and bignum storage. Positive cells must inspect actual variants/payloads.
DAG bignum storage created only when Nat flag true; configure before DAG creation, never flip false-to-true on existing absent storage.
mk_name_cache resolves syntactic names, not typed declarations. Symbols-present is not evidence that native declarations are valid.
Literal inference asserts corresponding flag then unwraps Nat/String type-name helper. Does not inspect declaration validity at these arms.
nat_type/string_type construct Const from cached names and empty universe slice; no environment lookup here.
Nat reconstruction asserts Nat enabled; zero needs cached Nat.zero, positive literal needs Nat.succ and returns a predecessor literal application.

String expansion requires both flags and cached Char, Char.ofNat, List.nil, List.cons, String.ofList. Uses Unicode scalar chars().rev() to build forward-order list and scalar NatLit payloads. Returns optional syntax, not semantic certification.
String defeq expansion delegates to constructor conversion then WHNF and defeq; unsupported conversion is None/false, not a declared input refusal.

Recursor reduction optionally expands literal major and retains original on absence; further recursor/rule/environment data is required.

candidate.independent_contract: The converter documentation at expr.rs:565 states String.ofList <| List.cons (Char.ofNat _) .. List.nil. This is scoped implementation-contract coverage, not a theorem about Lean semantics.
permanent_name_recipe: Create owned ExportFile with flags fixed before its LeanDag is created; preserve unchanged Empty/export bytes and empty declaration map.

For each hierarchy component intern CowStr::Borrowed into export.dag.strings; make StringPtr with DagMarker::ExportFile. Starting at export.dag.anonymous(), compute hash64!(STR_HASH, prefix, suffix) and intern Name::Str, returning ExportFile-marked NamePtr. Never reuse temporary TcCtx pointers.

Create exactly Char, Char.ofNat, List.nil, List.cons, String.ofList. Rebuild export.name_cache = export.dag.mk_name_cache() after all names are present and BEFORE entering with_ctx. Assert each expected cache field is Some with exact name identity.

Inside the one owning context use mk_string_lit_quick, require Some and Expr::StringLit with exact payload. Pass its actual StringPtr to str_lit_to_constructor; do not construct raw Expr nodes with invented hashes.
Inspect both empty and nonempty successful results with ordinary read_expr/unfold_apps/read_levels/read_bignum APIs and explicit oracle scalar values. Results must not escape the context.
